visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with rapid close-up shots of high-end titanium cups in various metallic finishes including textured black, gold, iridescent rainbow, and brushed silver, arranged on a light-colored table. (2) A man wearing a grey sweatshirt and a black baseball cap is seen in a brightly lit indoor showroom or office drinking from one of the cups; he carefully places it back on a table in front of him. (3) A shot of the exterior of a modern industrial building with a prominent green and white logo reading 'HORIE' is shown against a clear sky. (4) The scene shifts back indoors to a meeting room where the man in the cap sits across from an elderly gentleman in a white shirt; both are surrounded by numerous beverage containers on a long table. (5) A centered close-up of a dark, textured titanium cup appears, surrounded by several digital text bubbles representing social media comments from users. (6) A display of new, larger-sized conical titanium cups is showcased on a table set with silver circular trays. (7) Four packaged boxes are presented, each containing a cup in a different color: Rock Black, Gold, Titanium Rainbow, and Rock Silver. (8) Extremely detailed macro shots focus on the engraved logo on the cups, which features a sun-like emblem and the word 'SERIOUS'.
